title: Chapter 832
text:
"Hidden mission …" Han Xiao froze for a moment, but when he saw the mission reward, his face changed into a look of surprise.

A second [Bold Explorer] Skill Shard?

Han Xiao turned his head to look at Fu Ding, who was focused on the recording of the Yasr Civilization. While Fu Ding was not paying attention, Han Xiao went up to him and shook his shoulders.

"What … What are you doing?" Fu Ding looked at the happy Han Xiao in confusion.

"You're awesome!"

Han Xiaoxin was extremely happy. In his eyes, Fu Ding seemed to be glowing.

Ah, this dazzling European light!

Hidden missions had a small chance of giving out [Bold Explorer] Skill Shards. In the past four months, the players had discovered many hidden missions and shared them with him. However, he had never triggered this reward, and the Goddess of Luck was still looking down on him.

However, now that she had personally brought Fu Ding here, the Goddess of Luck would probably take the initiative to lift up her skirt and let Fu Ding see the Holy Light.

Han Xiao could not help but sigh. His charm was off the charts, his luck was extremely good, and he had a wife that was easy to get along with. Behind him, the Goddess of Luck was willing to be his mistress. Fu Ding was probably the biggest winner in life in the Black Star Corps.

Although Nero also had the Advanced Luck Glow, he could also arrange the Lady Luck Goddess, who despised the poor and loved the rich, into 108 different poses.

However … he was not handsome!

Compared to Fu Ding, Nero was like a little brother!

"You're still the most reliable." Han Xiao patted Fu Ding's shoulder with a gratified expression.

Fu Ding's face was filled with black … white question marks.

Seeing that everyone was looking at him with a puzzled expression, Han Xiao used a calming buff on himself, coughed, and casually explained.

"This civilization used their holy item to create this special amber. Other than us, no one else has set foot on this planet, so this holy item is ours. I guess this is another Universal Treasure."

The others did not know beforehand that Han Xiao had come to this planet with a clear goal, so they nodded and did not doubt him.

Han Xiao had the mechanical army search and found the database. Philip copied all the information in it and finally deciphered the language of the Yasr Civilization.

After updating the translator's language pack, everyone returned to the black disc and watched the recording of the Yasr civilization again. This time, they finally understood the content.

"I am the leader of the Yasreans, the lucky visitor. When you see this video, we may have already perished. No matter who you are, please finish watching this video …"

The mission introduction on the interface had already explained the general situation. Han Xiao listened to it again to perfect the details.

The video introduced the situation of the Yasrean civilization. This was all expected. At the end of the video, the Yasreans requested the visitor to complete two tasks. One was to unravel the effects of the Spacetime Amber. For this, they explained their research on the Spacetime Amber in detail. However, the Yasrean civilization did not have much research on this extraterrestrial object that was beyond their understanding.

The second thing was that if the Yasreans went extinct, they requested the visitor to preserve the information of the Yasrean civilization and leave behind traces of their existence.

They had been in the universe for many years, and they were already used to the destruction of civilizations. The universe was like this, with new species being born at every moment, and old species being destroyed. If they could feel everything, they would not be able to do anything else every day.

However, every civilization was a miracle of life. Their existence was their dignity, and they would still respect the last wish of a civilization.

However, before that, they had to get down to business first.

With the translation, the location of the ruins where the Spacetime Amber was was clear. Han Xiao had the mechanical army bring out all the amber from each ruin and gather at the location of the Spacetime Amber.

…

Everyone flew very quickly, and it did not take long for them to land at the ruins where the Spacetime Amber was.

Following the instructions in the image, Han Xiao came to an empty room in the central sanctuary of this ruin. A huge wall painting appeared in front of him. It was about eight meters tall and thirty meters long, and the history of the Yasreans was painted on it.

One of the pictures was of a black meteorite-like object falling from the clouds. A group of people below looked up. Han Xiao controlled his Mechanical Force and floated up. He came before this painting and reached out to touch the meteorite on the painting.

His palm pressed against the wall, and his energy blew away the thick layer of dust.

Hu!

The dust was blown away.

Han Xiao exerted force with his five fingers and broke the image of the meteorite. Rocks and soil fell.

Ka!

He dug out a pale white crystal from behind the wall, which was exactly the same shape as the meteorite image.

Looking at the white crystal in his hand, Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

This seemingly ordinary crystal ore was the core of the Spacetime Amber. It was hidden in this painting by the Yasreans, and the mechanical army could find it with three-dimensional scanning. However, it would obviously take more time.

You have received [Spacetime Amber].

Spacetime Amber: A Space Wonder item of unknown origin. It can freeze spacetime and form an amber-like substance that can be used to wrap various objects. Energy consumption will vary according to the size of the amber. Current Energy: 0

"Got it." Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed.

This was the easiest Universal Treasure to obtain. After all, other than himself, no one else knew of its existence.

This is the benefit of having an advantage in information … Han Xiao smiled.

He landed on the ground, and everyone immediately surrounded him, sizing up the Spacetime Amber curiously.

"This is the holy item that can create amber that can block all attacks?" Hella sized up the Spacetime Amber and asked, "Why is there no energy reaction at all?"

"This thing needs to be charged before it can be used."

Han Xiao explained. He then controlled his cells to spew out energy into the Spacetime Amber in his hand.

Boom!

An invisible shockwave exploded from Han Xiao's body like a hurricane. This was the aura of Han Xiao when he released all his energy, and dust flew up in the room.

The Mechanical Force surged into the Spacetime Amber, and the dim Spacetime Amber gradually lit up.

In the past four months, Han Xiao had already mastered [Heber Stellar Furnace Training] and spent 3.9 billion experience. His energy limit had permanently increased by more than 17,000, which was very worth it for him.

The Spacetime Amber was like a bottomless pit, and its energy value slowly increased. The conversion method of the Spacetime Amber's energy value was independent.

Using the Spacetime Amber required a large amount of energy, but to a Mechanic who had mastered psionic energy, they had as much energy as they wanted.

Han Xiao thought about it and did not use his own energy anymore. He took out a few psionic reactors and used them as chargers, connecting them to the Spacetime Amber through energy transmission pipes and continuously charging it. The Spacetime Amber seemed to have no limit to the amount of energy it could store, so he was not afraid of it exploding.

After charging, the Spacetime Amber immediately had an energy reaction.

Han Xiao held the Spacetime Amber in his hand and could feel the energy inside. The way to use the Spacetime Amber was very simple — he just needed to activate the energy inside.

The way the Yasre Civilization used it was rather crude and did not have much reference value. Han Xiao remembered that the owners of the Spacetime Amber in his previous life had a better way of using it. They could create a special activation device that resonated with the Spacetime Amber's frequency and wrap it around it. Then, they could use their nerves to control the Spacetime Amber. This way, they could use their consciousness to control the Spacetime Amber, and the control would be more sensitive and detailed.

With Han Xiao's current machinery level, it was very easy for him to create the activation device, but of course, now was not the time. He was not in a hurry to test the Spacetime Amber's ability and could complete the hidden mission first.

The group walked out of the central sanctuary of the ruins. All the Yasre amber had been moved to this ruin by the mechanical army, and there were so many of them that they could not see the end of it.

Han Xiao came in front of a Yasre amber, grabbed the main body of the Spacetime Amber, and slashed through the transparent amber that was immune to all attacks without any resistance.

The main body of the Spacetime Amber could easily pass through amber created by itself and would not be affected by the frozen spacetime.

Pop!

After being slashed open by the main body, the amber dissipated in the air like a bubble. The Yasre person inside immediately fell to the ground after being separated from the amber.

Aurora hurriedly helped him up and said in surprise, "There's a sign of life. He's still alive."

"His soul has already died. Although his body is still alive, he's already a living dead." Hella shook her head.

Unlike Aurora, she could sense the soul of life. Although this Yasre person's body was still alive, it was an empty shell.

Han Xiao scanned him. Due to the characteristics of the Spacetime Amber, this Yasre person's body remained in the state before it was frozen. Although his brain had stopped functioning, it did not show any signs of exhaustion and was still alive like the body. This meant that the brain was also frozen. However, if the brain was also frozen, then there should not be any mental activity.

He guessed that since the Spacetime Amber did not consume any physical energy, perhaps it was because it consumed soul energy to support mental activity? Then, the reason for the death of consciousness was the exhaustion of soul energy? The stronger the individual, the more soul energy they had, so they could last longer?

"That's not impossible." Thinking of the origin of the Spacetime Amber, Han Xiao did not feel that this phenomenon was strange.

The effect of the Spacetime Amber came from the Esper Ability of a Primordial One, which was the Super High Risk Esper Ability 'Freeze Spacetime'.

Most of the abilities on the Super High Risk Esper Ability list existed, and this Primordial One was the first Esper to be discovered with the ability to freeze spacetime.

Abilities like Smash Varudo were very rare, and it was also a high-level forbidden spell that was extremely difficult to master in the Mage class.

This Primordial One served an advanced civilization and died in battle. Another Primordial One with the ability to rewrite the nature of the existence of objects was his partner at that time. They turned his body into an indestructible crystal and buried him in the universe. However, the crystal might have absorbed some strange cosmic radiation during its countless years of wandering. Not only did it retain the ability to freeze spacetime, but its ability also mutated and became a Space Wonder. This was the origin of the Spacetime Amber. The players only knew about it in the later versions.

Putting away his thoughts, Han Xiao used the Spacetime Amber to remove the seal on all the Yasreans.

After checking, not a single soul was still alive.

"Sigh, they're all dead." Fu Ding shook his head and sighed.

Han Xiao originally had some hope, thinking that there might be some protagonists among the Yasreans who could survive, but unfortunately, there was none. Perhaps no one could escape death in the face of time.

You have removed the effect of the Spacetime Amber on all the Yasreans!

[Traces of Existence] completed!

You have received 1.5 trillion EXP and 780 Exploration Points.

You have received 1 Random Reward.

You have received 1 Legendary Point.

Han Xiao sighed. "Philip, move these bodies onto the ship, burn them, and bury them in the universe."

Fu Ding looked over. "Aren't you going to use the Spacetime Amber to leave a sample?"

"Their souls will disappear with the civilization. Let their bodies be free as well."

Han Xiao shook his head. He had already scanned the data of the Yasreans' bodies, and there was nothing special about them. Furthermore, the Spacetime Amber had not appeared yet, so he planned to use it as a trump card and did not want to leave any clues behind.

He still remembered that he was a member of the Spacetime Research Association. This association kept the information of every extinct civilization and displayed it to outsiders so that more people could understand the civilizations that had once existed in this universe.

Giving this information to the Spacetime Research Association should be a better place for this civilization.

"Master, hum … Do you want me to upload the information of the Yasrean civilization to the Spacetime Research Association's database?"

"Go ahead."

Han Xiao nodded.

With the Spacetime Amber in hand, the group returned to the fleet and set off.

In different spaceships, the corpses of the Yasreans were sent into the incinerator and scattered into the universe. The fleet left behind a trail of embers that looked like a trail of sparks.

…

The fleet entered hyperdrive mode, and Han Xiao temporarily rejected Hardaway's invitation to wrestle. He locked himself in the machinery modification room and prepared to create a convenient device for using the Spacetime Amber.

Instruments were connected to the Spacetime Amber and were measuring its parameters. Han Xiao stood at the side and looked down at the Spacetime Amber that was constantly emitting a halo.

"This is the second Universal Treasure I've obtained, and it's equivalent to a new trump card. The Evolution Cube has the effect of gene evolution, and the Spacetime Amber can freeze time …"

Han Xiao thought to himself.

The Evolution Cube could be used to build relationships, and the Spacetime Amber … could be used as a deterrent?

This time, Han Xiao suddenly had an idea.

Since the Spacetime Amber could block the transmission of energy, if he wrapped up the Evolution Cube … would Sisko not be able to sense it?

"This feels promising. Anyway, I don't usually use the Evolution Cube, and I can just remove it when I need to use it. I just don't know if this will be able to stop Sisko … However, the Arcane Church will most likely not give up." Han Xiao pondered.

He planned to install a convenient device for the Spacetime Amber first before testing the feasibility of this idea. Anyway, to him, building a small device would not take more than a few minutes.

Putting this matter aside for the time being, Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at the skill list.

He had already obtained the two skill fragments of [Bold Explorer]. This skill had been activated, and he would be able to obtain some information when exploring the unknown and identifying items.

"The cooldown time is seven days, and the side effect is to reduce Luck for fourteen days. Tsk, where would I have Luck to reduce?"

All the side effects of Luck are nothing to me!

Han Xiao smiled proudly.

… Wait a minute, this does not seem to be something to be proud of!

Turning around, Han Xiao's eyes focused.

He might as well test the effect of this skill on the Spacetime Amber.

He knew the origin of the Spacetime Amber, and he could use it to test the accuracy of this skill.
